about_the_game: Composed by Remi Gallego aka The Algorithm (Rematch, The Last Spell, VOIN), the Abyssus game soundtrack delivers a high-energy mix of jungle, drum’n’bass and warped sci-fi textures. This album, fueled by breakbeats and low-end pressure, mirrors the game’s fast-paced chaos with style and tongue-in-cheek flair. The tracks will surely resonate with fans of adrenaline-packed electronic soundtracks.
